# Human–AI Systems

> UK AI adoption consultancy founded and led by Mike McKeown. Helps organisations move from AI experimentation to disciplined, value-creating operational adoption: workflow redesign, governance and hybrid human-AI operating models. Also runs From Prompt to Autopilot, a programme (with Third Circle) that builds functional leaders, business owners and their teams their own Business AI Operating System and teaches them to run and extend it. Run as a private team programme, an individual seat, or a company-wide rollout.

Key frameworks: Tool → Assistant → Worker (capability maturity); Radar → Pilot → Scale (adoption methodology); Hybrid Workforce Leadership.

Sectors: local government, financial services, professional services, SaaS and technology, small and mid-market organisations.

- [How Human-AI Systems runs](https://human-ai-systems.com/how-has-runs/): a real, one-person consultancy running on a Business AI Operating System, with a named AI team, around thirty scheduled routines, the dashboards, and written rules on what waits for a human
- [Meet Lumen](https://human-ai-systems.com/from-prompt-to-autopilot/meet-lumen/): a synthetic reference company running entirely on a Business AI Operating System, with eleven role dashboards and a before-and-after working week for each leader
